## 3. What landed (all default ON, `?flag=off` escapes; docs in `docs/url-flags.md`)

| flag / fix | file | one line |
|---|---|---|
| NanScrub fixed | `scene3d/atmosphere_pipeline.js` | SRC blend + exponent-bit non-finite test + clamp ≥0 (was a no-op; whole frame black on 1070) |
| `drawSortProgram` live again | `scene3d/draw_sort_program.js` | `?punchRetail` used to replace the sort; phase is now the primary key (`setDrawSortPhase`) |
| `occlusionCull` | `scene3d/occlusion_cull.js` (+ cells.js, entities.js) | GPU occlusion queries: interior cells + NPC rigs behind walls not drawn; live seam `window.__occlusionCull.off` |
| `asyncLink` | `scene3d/async_link_guard.js` | a draw whose program is new / linking / re-keyed (kind, geometry signature, never-drawn) is skipped and compiled off-frame; seam `window.__asyncLink.off` |
| `skipHiddenMatrix` | `scene3d/skip_hidden_matrix.js` | scene walk skips invisible subtrees (uses `matrixWorldNeedsUpdate`); seam `window.__skipHiddenMatrix.on` |
| `particleInstancing` + `particleInstancingAlpha` | `scene3d/particles/particle_manager.js` | alpha + additive particles instanced per (gfxobj, layer, blend), static AND world managers |
| `texWorkers` | `scene3d/xu7_textures.js` | texture worker default on where Web Workers exist |
| `batchMatVariant` = clones | `scene3d/batched_material_variant.js` | variants are shape-identical clones synced per frame (`syncBatchMatVariants`), NOT `Object.create` (megamorphic material reads, 2.2× slower) |
| light-rescan storm | `scene3d/index.js` | idempotent envcell loads no longer re-run `_rescanSetupLights` (was 20/s) |
| fog-probe stall | `scene3d/loop.js` | readability queries memoised; probe skips while `asyncLinkBusy()` |
| NRA pack LUT | `scene3d/static_atlas.js` | byte-identical, 2.4× faster |

New tests (tier 5 in `harness/run-js-headless.mjs`): `test_occlusion_cull`, `test_async_link_guard`,
`test_skip_hidden_matrix`, `test_particle_inst_alpha`, `test_nra_pack_lut`, `test_batch_mat_variant_clone`.

**Lesson worth keeping:** never add properties to three.js materials / scene nodes in varying orders,
and never hand three prototype-derived (`Object.create`) materials — V8 hidden-class explosion turns
three's hot material reads megamorphic for EVERY draw.

## 4. How to measure (tools in `external/holtburger/scripts/perf-worker/`, README section 2026-10-06)

Read memory `fleet-runbooks.md` (1070 section) before touching the box. Box rules: Chrome launched by
schtasks `/it` with `--mute-audio`, off-screen, own `--user-data-dir` under `D:\Temp\hbbench\`; kill
ONLY by that profile path (`hbsess.mjs kill`); never `taskkill /IM chrome.exe`; the box is a person's PC.

```bash
# tunnel (THREE forwards: CDP, app server, ws bridge)
ssh -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o BatchMode=yes -fN -L 9333:127.0.0.1:9333 \
    -R 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 -R 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 young@100.127.215.75
cd external/holtburger/scripts/perf-worker
node hbsess.mjs boot --quality mid --flags 'skytime=12'   # ~3 min; waits for ACE logout of the last run
node hbsess.mjs eval some.js                              # page-side async snippet, no reboot
node hbsess.mjs snap out.jpg                              # real 3D frame (page.screenshot is black)
node hbsess.mjs profile 8 out.cpuprofile [street]         # CPU profile while orbiting / street sweep
node hbsess.mjs tourprof base poi:Shoushi 35000           # profile + frame stamps over a teleport
python3 tourattr.py base 60                               # what ran inside every frame >= 60 ms
node hbbench.mjs --arms arms.json --reps 2 --port 8766    # interleaved fresh-boot A/B (bench a FROZEN copy:
./hb-mksnap.sh s1 && (cd /mnt/wbterminal2/hb-snap/s1 && python3 scripts/serve.py --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 8766 &)
#   …and add  -R 8766:127.0.0.1:8766  to the tunnel. Lets you keep editing while a bench runs.)
node hbsess.mjs kill                                      # ALWAYS before you finish
```
Gotchas: one Chrome at a time on the box (a new boot kills the last); single ACE login account
`tailnet1` (the scripts wait for its LOGOUT line); never `pkill -f PATTERN` where the pattern is in
your own command line (exit 144 = you killed yourself) — find PIDs by port (`ss -ltnp`) or `pgrep -x`.
Probe traps (session 2): (a) any material/program swap is SKIPPED by `?asyncLink` while it links — set
`window.__asyncLink.off = true` during swap experiments or a "fix" is just a missing draw; (b) before
`8b537b32`, three's async readback left a PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER bound every 12th frame and readPixels read
pure black — check `gl.getError()` after any readPixels before believing a black frame.

## 5. END-OF-SESSION PROTOCOL (mandatory, start at hard stop − 25 min)

1. Stop new work. Anything half-done → behind a default-OFF flag, or revert it.
2. Targeted tests for every file you touched (`node test_x.mjs` from `apps/holtburger-web/`); register any
   new test file in `harness/run-js-headless.mjs` (tier 5) or the gate reports it UNREGISTERED.
3. Full JS gate ONCE, inside the memory cap (laptop rules, `~/CLAUDE.md`): `free -m` must show ≥2.5 GB
   available, then from `apps/holtburger-web/`: `capped-build node harness/run-js-headless.mjs`.
   Baseline (session 3): 404 passed / 0 failed, exit 0 (the two formerly unregistered suites are in tier 5
   now) — any FAIL line is yours.
4. Update `docs/url-flags.md` for any flag you added or whose default you changed.
5. Commit + push + merge to origin/master:
   ```bash
   cd /home/wbterminal/WorldBuilder-ACME-Edition
   git fetch origin && git status -sb
   git checkout -b <topic-branch>            # if you are on master
   git add -A <only the paths you changed> && git commit   # message style: "holtburger-web: <what the player sees>"
   git checkout master && git pull --ff-only origin master
   git merge --ff-only <topic-branch> || git rebase master <topic-branch>   # then merge again
   git push origin master
   git log -1 --oneline origin/master        # must show your commit
   git status -sb                            # must be clean and "## master...origin/master"
   ```
   End the commit message with the attribution trailer your harness gives you.
6. Clean up: `node hbsess.mjs kill` (box Chrome), kill any snapshot server you started (by port), close
   your SSH tunnels (`pgrep -x ssh` + match the args), and confirm `tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq chrome.exe"`
   on the box shows none of yours.
7. Final message to the owner: what changed, measured before/after, what is left, and the pushed commit hash.
